pois.name: The Dalmore Distillery
pois.intro: Dalmore distillery is located in Alness, Scotland, 20 miles north of Inverness. It sits on the banks of the Cromarty Firth overlooking the Black Isle, the "big meadowland" from which it takes its name.

pois.name: Teaninich
pois.intro: Teaninich distillery is a Highland single malt Scotch whisky distillery in Alness, Scotland.

pois.name: Castle Craig
pois.intro: Castlecraig, also known as Craig Castle and Castle Craig, is a 16th-century fortification located on the north shore of the Black Isle in northern Scotland. It is on the south coast of the Cromarty Firth, 5 kilometres north-east of Culbokie and 19 kilometres north of the city of Inverness.

pois.name: Invergordon Arts Centre
pois.intro: Invergordon Town Hall is a municipal building in the High Street in Invergordon in the Highland area of Scotland. The structure, which is used as a community events venue, is a Category B listed building.

pois.name: Cromarty Lighthouse
pois.intro: p4 Das Cromarty Lighthouse, deutsch Cromarty-Leuchtturm, ist ein Leuchtturm in der schottischen Ortschaft Cromarty in der Council Area Highland. 1971 wurde der Leuchtturm in den schottischen Denkmallisten in der höchsten Denkmalkategorie A aufgenommen.

pois.name: The Old Court house
pois.intro: Das Cromarty Courthouse Museum ist ein Museum im ehemaligen Justizgebäude der schottischen Ortschaft Cromarty in der Council Area Highland. 1971 wurde das Bauwerk in die schottischen Denkmallisten in der höchsten Denkmalkategorie A aufgenommen.

pois.name: Inchindown RN Underground Fuel Tanks
pois.intro: The Inchindown oil tanks is a disused underground oil depot in Invergordon, Ross-shire, Scotland. The tanks hold the record for the longest reverberation in any man-made structure, surpassing the Hamilton Mausoleum in 2014.

pois.name: Donkey Bridge
pois.description: The small bridge providing pedestrian access from the western end of the town to the foreshore and the coast road. This access existed in 1880 from the Beech Wood, which formed part of the Castle estate, to the main route from Invergordon to Alness.

pois.name: HMS Natal Memorial
pois.description: Anchor from HMS Natal. The warrior-class armored cruiser blew up in harbor in 1915.

pois.name: Invergordon Distillery
pois.intro: Invergordon distillery is a grain whisky distillery located at Invergordon in Easter Ross, in Ross and Cromarty, Highland, Scotland. The distillery is operated by Whyte & Mackay, which Philippines-based Alliance Global owns.
